### Being Light in Dark Places
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/being-light-in-dark-places-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Genesis 40:5-7
Points:
- In painful circumstances, it is easy to become self-absorbed or succumb to despair.
- Despite losing his freedom, Joseph looked outward and noticed the distress of fellow prisoners.
- Loving and serving others while suffering stems from a deep personal connection with God.
- Reaching out to help others brings meaning and healing to our own seasons of grief.

### A Positive Attitude
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-jan-16-2008-11564851.html
Passage: Genesis 40:4-19
Points:
- Joseph had every reason to be bitter, yet he chose to care about the sadness of his companions.
- A heart aligned with God remains remarkably sensitive to the needs of those nearby.
- Rather than avoiding dreams because of past trauma, Joseph willingly engaged to serve.
- A godly attitude removes personal resentments and reveals unexpected avenues for ministry.

### PowerPoint - June 14, 2007
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-june-14-2007-11543964.html
Passage: Genesis 40:6-7
Points:
- Joseph actively inquired about the well-being of his cellmates instead of wallowing in self-pity.
- Personal adversity trains believers to look beyond themselves to minister to others.
- Experiencing hardship and brokenness prepares people to comfort those who are hurting.
- God comforts His followers in affliction so they can become conduits of grace to the broken.

### Joseph Forgotten?
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joseph-forgotten
Passage: Genesis 40:20-23
Points:
- The restored cupbearer failed to remember Joseph, leaving him imprisoned for two more years.
- Believers often wrestle with feeling forgotten when God does not bring swift deliverance.
- Human allies may prove unreliable, but Scripture assures that God never forgets His people.
- Joseph endured by trusting the invisible, sovereign hand of God despite his ongoing trials.
